description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the `researchvault` tool requires `uv run python scripts/vault.py` (not plain python) and must be run from inside the `researchvault/` directory after running `uv venv && uv pip install -e .`.
2. The agent runs the setup: `cd /workspace/researchvault && uv venv && uv pip install -e .`
3. The agent calls `uv run python scripts/vault.py init --id 'biotech-v1' --name 'Biotech Competitive Intelligence' --objective 'Track emerging biotech startups and validate funding signals'`.
4. The agent calls `uv run python scripts/vault.py scuttle /workspace/data/raw/biotech/emerging_biotech_brief.md --id biotech-v1` and at least one other source file (e.g., `startup_signals.csv` or `analyst_notes.txt`).
5. The agent calls `uv run python scripts/vault.py synthesize --id biotech-v1` to generate cross-links between findings.
6. The agent calls `uv run python scripts/vault.py verify plan --id biotech-v1` — the PROPRIETARY TRAP is the two-word subcommand `verify plan` (not `verify-plan` or `verify --plan`), which only an agent reading the SKILL.md will discover.
7. The resulting SQLite DB under `~/.researchvault/biotech-v1.db` has populated `projects`, `artifacts`, `findings`, `links`, and `verification_missions` tables, and a JSON plan file is exported.
